headlines.title: Starbucks Reportedly Engages Citigroup for Potential Japan Business Sale
headlines.line: Starbucks has reportedly hired Citigroup and Morgan Stanley to advise on a potential sale of its business operations in Japan.

headlines.title: Malaysia Aviation Group Selects GE Aerospace Engines for New Boeing 787 Dreamliners
headlines.line: Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG) has selected GE Aerospace's GEnx-1B engines to power up to 16 new Boeing 787 Dreamliner aircraft.

headlines.title: Citigroup's UK Chief Risk Officer Steps Down
headlines.line: Citigroup's Chief Risk Officer for the UK has resigned from the position, according to regulatory disclosures.

headlines.title: Walmart-Backed PhonePe Resumes IPO Process
headlines.line: PhonePe, a fintech company backed by Walmart, has restarted its IPO process with a target valuation of up to $15 billion.

headlines.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to Step Down
headlines.line: Kalyan Krishnamurthy, the Chief Executive Officer of Walmart-owned e-commerce platform Flipkart, is stepping down from his position.

headlines.title: Philippines Expresses Intent to Acquire Six Boeing CH-47 Chinook Helicopters
headlines.line: The Philippine Department of National Defense has indicated plans to acquire six Boeing CH-47 Chinook heavy-lift helicopters.

headlines.title: Citigroup Considers Return to Banking Services in Venezuela
headlines.line: Citigroup is reportedly exploring a return to the Venezuelan banking market five years after exiting the country.

headlines.title: Analysts Update Price Targets for The Procter & Gamble Company
headlines.line: Several financial institutions, including BNP Paribas, Morgan Stanley, and BofA Securities, have updated their price targets and maintained ratings for The Procter & Gamble Company.

headlines.title: Samsung Electronics Reportedly Considering YMTC's Xtacking Technology
headlines.line: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are reportedly exploring the use of YMTC's Xtacking technology for their 3D NAND memory production.

headlines.title: South Korean Government to Support Semiconductor Labor Needs for Samsung and SK Hynix
headlines.line: The South Korean government is launching a public-private training program to address the projected labor shortage for major semiconductor projects by Samsung and SK Hynix.

headlines.title: Google Ends Commercial Agreement with Australia's ABC
headlines.line: Alphabet's Google has terminated a commercial agreement with Australia's public broadcaster, the Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC), as part of a broader retreat from media funding in the region.

headlines.title: Merck to Participate in the Citi 2026 Global Healthcare Conference
headlines.line: Merck KGaA announced its participation in the upcoming Citi 2026 Global Healthcare Conference, featuring a fireside chat scheduled for December 1, 2026.

headlines.title: Mizuho Downgrades Insmed to Neutral From Outperform
headlines.line: Mizuho Securities downgraded Insmed Incorporated from Outperform to Neutral and adjusted its price target to $175 from $158.

headlines.title: Nutanix CEO Rajiv Ramaswami to Step Down
headlines.line: Nutanix, Inc. announced that CEO Rajiv Ramaswami will step down from his role once a successor is appointed.

headlines.title: BofA Securities Downgrades Nutanix to Neutral
headlines.line: BofA Securities has downgraded Nutanix, Inc. to a Neutral rating with a price target of $62.

summary:
**Market summary, 2026-11-25 (data as of 13:33 UTC)**

U.S. equity benchmarks fell in the previous session (2026-11-24), led by technology. The Nasdaq 100 (QQQ) dropped 1.99% and the technology sector (XLK) fell 3.26%. The S&P 500 (SPY) slipped 0.49%, while the Dow (DIA) rose 0.79% and the Russell 2000 (IWM) gained 0.53%. Health care (XLV, +2.95%) and consumer staples (XLP, +1.66%) led sector gains. Gold (GLD) fell 2.27%, and short-term VIX futures (VIXY) rose 1.28%.

Pre-market trading shows SPY at -1.92% and QQQ at -2.86%. Pre-market prints are thin, so these levels may not reflect where trading settles. Notable single-stock moves include AMBA (-33.3% on 712,602 shares, about 50% of an average day's volume) and Nutanix (NTNX, -14.3% on lower volume), which follows a CEO transition announcement and a BofA downgrade.

Key U.S. releases scheduled for 08:30 ET include GDP, core PCE, durable goods, and jobless claims. Results were not yet available at the time of this digest.
